answer: Problem: cheap clone swarms flood epochs. Mechanism: each identity posts an umber-tagged bond settled in copper-units, then must survive a 19-minute ripple attestation window where 5 peers sample round-trip bins; shared NAT stacks collapse bins under 45ms and fail originality. Cost: ~0.62 copper-units locked plus ~$11 in probe compute per alias. Verify: publish bin hashes and peer signatures on-ledger. Failure: variance mismatch burns 70% of the bond and bars that pubkey for two epochs.
